basic_info.description: Nestled in the fabled Hamilton Building, this beautifully appointed studio offers a perfect blend of style, functionality, and comfort. Featuring a thoughtful layout with a cozy sleeping alcove, the space is designed for both relaxation and efficiency. The custom kitchen is a standout, complete with sleek concrete countertops, modern cabinetry, and high-end finishes, ideal for cooking and entertaining.     The custom closet provides ample storage space, maximizing every inch of the studio for a clutter-free living experience.The remodeled bathroom is a modern oasis, featuring stylish, contemporary finishes and thoughtful design. With updated fixtures, sleek tiling, and a fresh, clean aesthetic, it provides a relaxing and functional space for your daily routine. With expansive North-facing views, you'll enjoy natural light throughout the day, along with a serene outlook over the city. Building is an Art-Deco gem featuring a double height lobby, 24-hour desk, ballroom, gym and a 16th floor sky deck. Perfectly positioned for access to the best of San Francisco, this studio offers a rare opportunity to live in style and comfort close the city's most desirable locations
